methodologyNotes: Products are the 11-12 most-searched corded and cordless reciprocating saw models in the US market, spanning full-size Sawzalls, compact one-handed HackZalls, and professional corded models from Milwaukee, DeWalt, Makita, Bosch, Ryobi, Metabo HPT, and Black+Decker. Specs re-verified against official manufacturer product pages (milwaukeetool.com, dewalt.com, makitatools.com, boschtools.com, ryobitools.com, metabo-hpt.com, blackanddecker.com), manufacturer press releases, and corroborated via professional review outlets (Pro Tool Reviews) and major distributors (Ohio Power Tool, ToolNut, Acme Tools). ADVERSARIAL CORRECTIONS: (1) Three 'brushless' claims were fabricated and set to false after primary-source checks — Bosch GSA18V-083B (brushed; brushless variant is GSA18V-125N), Ryobi P519 (brushed; brushless variant is P517), and Milwaukee HackZall 2625-20 (brushed; brushless variant is M18 FUEL 2719-20). (2) The DeWalt DWE305 source URL in the draft (legacy /products/power-tools/... path) returned HTTP 404 and was replaced with the live dewalt.com /en-us/product/ URL. (3) The Metabo HPT CR13VST source URL path was corrected to the canonical /power-tools/saws/product/ path. The prompt model 'Metabo HPT CR13VBST' does not exist; verified model is CR13VST (11A). Weight values are bare-tool unless the tool ships with battery (Makita XRJ05Z weight is with battery, per official page). Prices are published US figures (MSRP where available; current retail otherwise). accessedAt 2026-06-20.
